IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_anatolianshepherd: A large, courageous livestock guardian with a pale fawn coat, cream underside and dark facial mask. It learns combat quickly, carries larger saddlebags and helps calm its owner's panic.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_greaterswissmountaindo: A large, courageous tricolor working dog bred to guard farms, pull carts and drive livestock. It learns combat quickly, carries larger saddlebags and helps calm its owner's panic.
